name: @sylphx/workflow-mcp

tools.name: workflow_plan
tools.description: Run a governed, READ-ONLY planning workflow on a model OUTSIDE this host's own (Codex/GPT-5.5). Returns a structured, agent-ready plan artifact (recommended plan, rejected alternatives, assumptions, approval gates, smallest first slice, validation plan, risks, a handoff prompt, and a review trigger) wrapped in a WorkflowRunEnvelope that discloses the backend/model/egress. Advisory — it never approves. The planner may only READ a server-allowlisted project root (no writes); a cwd outside it is rejected.

task.description: The design/planning question or unit of work to plan.

context.description: Optional extra context (constraints, prior decisions, links).

cwd.description: A directory INSIDE the server's allowed project root to READ (no writes). Defaults to the allowed root. Paths outside it are rejected.

backend.description: A CONFIGURED backend id to run on (e.g. an owner-gateway / OpenAI-compatible model). Must be a key in config.json backends — never an arbitrary URL. Defaults to the workflow's configured backend.

workflow_session_id.description: Stable id to chain a Second-Mind handoff across calls (reserved; advisory in this slice).

tools.name: workflow_analyze
tools.description: Run a governed, READ-ONLY ANALYSIS workflow on a model OUTSIDE this host's own (Codex/GPT-5.5) — an independent, evaluative second opinion on a design, a diff, a piece of code, a tradeoff, or a question. Returns a structured assessment (findings with severity + evidence, honest strengths, prioritised recommendations, open questions, and an overall verdict + confidence) wrapped in a WorkflowRunEnvelope that discloses the backend/model/egress. Advisory — it never approves; only the review gate does. Reads only a server-allowlisted project root (no writes); a cwd outside it is rejected.

task.description: What to analyze (a design, a diff, code, a tradeoff, a question) and what you want assessed.

context.description: Optional extra context (constraints, prior decisions, links).

cwd.description: A directory INSIDE the server's allowed project root to READ (no writes). Defaults to the allowed root. Paths outside it are rejected.

backend.description: A CONFIGURED backend id to run on (e.g. an owner-gateway / OpenAI-compatible model). Must be a key in config.json backends — never an arbitrary URL. Defaults to the workflow's configured backend.

workflow_session_id.description: Stable id to chain a Second-Mind handoff across calls (reserved; advisory in this slice).

context.description: Optional extra context (constraints, prior decisions, links).

cwd.description: A directory INSIDE the server's allowed project root to READ (no writes). Defaults to the allowed root. Paths outside it are rejected.

backend.description: A CONFIGURED backend id to run on (e.g. an owner-gateway / OpenAI-compatible model). Must be a key in config.json backends — never an arbitrary URL. Defaults to the workflow's configured backend.

tools.name: workflow_discuss
tools.description: Run a governed, READ-ONLY DISCUSSION workflow on a model OUTSIDE this host's own (Codex/GPT-5.5) — an independent dialectic on a decision or question: it steelmans the real candidate positions, surfaces the crux, and recommends. task.description: The decision or question to discuss dialectically (and any constraints).

context.description: Optional extra context (constraints, prior decisions, links).

tools.name: workflow_council
tools.description: Run ONE base workflow (plan / analyze / research) across SEVERAL configured backends at once and return the whole panel — N independent governed opinions from N different models in a single call, plus a participation summary (who ran, who succeeded, which egresses). A live eval harness / multi-model second opinion. Advisory — it never approves; only the review gate does. Each panel member runs read-only inside the server-allowlisted root; an unknown backend in the panel degrades only its own slot.

base_workflow.description: Which curated workflow each backend runs.

task.description: The task/question/subject handed to every panel member.

context.description: Optional extra context, given to every member.

cwd.description: A directory INSIDE the server's allowed root for members to READ (no writes). Defaults to the allowed root.

backends.description: The panel: CONFIGURED backend ids. Each must be a key in config.json backends — never a URL. Duplicates are removed; a panel beyond 8 is run to the cap and the truncation is disclosed (summary.requested > ran).

tools.name: workflow_review
tools.description: Run the gpt-review gate on a unit of work — the ONLY workflow with approval authority. It runs the full convergence review (an independent repo-grounded model investigates the change set, burns down a verdict across rounds) and returns a structured verdict: approve, or request_changes with the open issues + how to resolve each. One round per call: fix the issues and call again with the SAME session to converge. request_changes is a successful review (not an error). Reads only a server-allowlisted root; never writes.

task.description: A summary of the unit of work + key decisions (what the gate reviews; passed as the review context).

cwd.description: The project directory to review (INSIDE the server's allowed root). Defaults to the allowed root.

base.description: Optional review base git ref (overrides the default change-set base).

session.description: Stable convergence id — pass the SAME id each round to burn the verdict down (e.g. the ADR number or a branch/topic slug). Required to track a plan/brief review across rounds.

scope.description: What to review: auto (default), diff (code change set), or brief (a plan/decision with no files).
